harness.scene: The area is a 3D scan of a real rural property: two timber cottages, a garage, trees, fences and a garden, open to the sky. An altitude geofence a few metres above the ground acts like a roof, so the drone cannot climb over the houses or trees.

review.detail: Review decision “selected-for-residential-delivery”: Selected on 2026-11-15 for the garden delivery task.

scale.detail: Not measured. Recorded so far: Scene units; roughly metres (the rear porch roof sits about 2.5 units above its floor) but not independently calibrated. (Shown for information; not enforced.)

passage.detail: Narrowest gap on the flight graph: 0.90 m (the drone is 0.50 m wide) at [-12.6, 6.4, -12.7].

alignment.detail: 99.4% of 6557 sampled surface cells of the scan's own collider (the altitude fence and sealed hollows excluded) have scan points within 0.50 m (needs 90%).

coverage.detail: 100% of 74 waypoints have captured scan ground below them (needs 90%). Captured means at least 123 scan points within 2 m (5% of this scan's median, 2458). 0 waypoints sit over ground with no scan surface within 2.5 m (ground we sealed).
